description: Dataset supporting the study titled "Tropical Cyclone Vulnerability of Coastal Communities in Mtwara Municipal Council, Tanzania: A Composite Vulnerability Index Approach." is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley Data. This dataset supports the study titled “Tropical Cyclone Vulnerability of Coastal Communities in Mtwara Municipal Council, Tanzania: A Composite Vulnerability Index Approach.” It contains household-survey data collected in December 2025 from 100 randomly selected households distributed across all 19 wards of Mtwara Municipal Council. Coverage: Tanzania. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley Data. Its tags are Urban Vulnerability to Climate Change, Vulnerability, Tropical Cyclone. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
